title: Distributionally Robust Insurance under Bregman-Wasserstein Divergence
abstract: arXiv:2604.27837v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper investigates two optimal insurance contracting problems under distributional uncertainty from the perspective of a potential policyholder, utilizing a Bregman-Wasserstein (BW) ball to characterize the ambiguity set of loss distributions. The first problem examines an insurance demand model where the policyholder adopts an $\alpha$-maxmin preference with Value-at-Risk (VaR). We derive the optimal indemnity function in closed form and study, both analytically and numerically, how the asymmetry inherent in BW divergence influences the optimal indemnity structure. The second problem employs a robust optimization framework, where the policyholder aims to secure robust insurance indemnity by minimizing the worst-case convex distortion risk measure while adhering to a guaranteed VaR constraint. translated_title: 基于Bregman-Wasserstein散度的分布鲁棒保险
translated_abstract: 本文从潜在投保人的视角，研究分布不确定性下的两个最优保险合同问题，并利用Bregman-Wasserstein（BW）球来刻画损失分布的模糊集。第一个问题考察了一个保险需求模型，其中投保人采用结合风险价值的风险度量α-maxmin偏好。我们推导出了最优赔偿函数的闭式解，并从解析和数值两个层面研究了BW散度固有的不对称性如何影响最优赔偿结构。第二个问题采用鲁棒优化框架，投保人在遵守给定的VaR约束的前提下，通过最小化最坏情况下的凸扭曲风险度量来获得鲁棒的保险赔偿。在此背景下，我们以闭式形式给出了最优赔偿和最坏情况分布的显式刻画。
tldr: 本文利用Bregman-Wasserstein散度刻画损失分布的不确定性，在两个最优保险合同问题中闭式求解了最优赔偿函数与最坏情况分布，并揭示了BW散度的不对称性对最优赔偿结构的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper solves two optimal insurance contracting problems under distributional ambiguity using Bregman-Wasserstein balls, deriving closed-form optimal indemnity functions and worst-case distributions, and revealing how the asymmetry of BW divergence shapes the optimal indemnity structure.
